bullets.text: CloudPe launched its new IN-NORTH1 cloud and artificial intelligence infrastructure region at Yotta's Tier IV data center in Noida.
The office should monitor Leapswitch Networks' expansion strategy to evaluate potential partnerships for Tamil Nadu's artificial intelligence infrastructure growth.

stories.title: CloudPe launches Noida cloud region at Yotta's Tier IV data center
takeaways: CloudPe launched its new IN-NORTH1 cloud region at Yotta's 3-lakh-square-foot Tier IV data center facility.
The platform aims to expand Indian cloud and artificial intelligence infrastructure capabilities significantly nationwide.
stories.snippet: NEW DELHI: CloudPe, the Indian cloud and artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure platform by Leapswitch Networks, on Thursday said it has launched its new cloud region, IN-NORTH1, at Yotta's 3-lakh-sq.-ft. Tier IV…
